services.name: Miramar Beach Parasail
services.desc: The ONLY Parasailing Company on the beach in Destin! USA TODAY 10 BEST PARASAILING and WSIA Award of Excellence!

services.name: Banana Boat Ride
services.desc: We operate right off the beach right behind Pompano Joe's in Miramar Beach! Our captain is the highest rated in Destin and holds a USCG license. He will tailor the ride to suit your preference. The rides average about 12-14 minutes holding a maximum of 6 passengers at a time. Banana Boat Captain will not operate faster than 20 mph due to safety regulations. Riders must follow safety rules or ride will be terminated for your safety, without refund. Please do not bring personal items such as cell phones or anything you do not want to lose. We commonly see marine life such as dolphins, sea Have a whale of a time with the highest rated banana captains on the Gulf!

services.name: Banana/Parasail Combo
services.desc: Give your family the ultimate watersports experience by combining a banana boat ride AND a parasailing Best Value! Parasail and banana boat for one low price!

services.name: Dip with the Dolphins Parasail
services.desc: We highly recommend taking this first parasail flight of the day to search for dolphins, sea turtles and other marine life from our Pompano Joe's Beach Location in Destin on Miramar Beach. The seas are typically the calmest in the morning giving us the best opportunity to locate marine life for your viewing pleasure. This trip is a must for the dolphin/sea turtle lover. Dolphin sightings cannot be guaranteed, but this is the best time of day to spot Early morning is the best time to see dolphins and other sea life!

services.name: Sunset Parasailing on Miramar Beach
services.desc: We are the ONLY beach parasailing company to offer a sunset flight. Our "Premier Flight" the Sunset Parasail is an experience you will not want to miss. Get the best sunset experience from the unimpeded views only available from high above the Gulf of Mexico. A photo package is a must on this Most Beautiful Flight of the day!

services.name: Banana Boat Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: 25-30 minute dolphin cruise on a banana boat pulled by a USCG Licensed Captain along the beautiful Emerald Coast Get up close to marine life on a banana boat!

services.name: Crab Island Parasailing
services.desc: Our dock location is a great option for a smooth sunset flight or when the beach has double red flags! We load directly off the dock and parasail in the protected areas of the bay where there are no waves. Try our SUNSET PARASAIL, the most beautiful flight of the Come parasailing in the Bay with Fort Walton Beach Parasail!
